article.headline: Indrusaitis and Cooper net 21 apiece to lift California over Utah Tech 79-73
article.description: — Nojus Indrusaitis and Michael Cooper scored 21 points apiece as California rallied from a nine-point halftime deficit to beat Utah Tech 79-73 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Indrusaitis and Cooper net 21 apiece to lift California over Utah Tech 79-73

categories.description: Utah Tech Trailblazers @ California Golden Bears

event.description: Utah Tech Trailblazers @ California Golden Bears

keywords: Utah Tech Trailblazers @ California Golden Bears
article.story: BERKELEY, Calif. -- — Nojus Indrusaitis and Michael Cooper scored 21 points apiece as California rallied from a nine-point halftime deficit to beat Utah Tech 79-73 on Saturday. The Golden Bears (3-2) trailed 41-32 at the break and were down 67-56 with 9:19 remaining before closing the game on a 23-6 run. Cal's Semetri Carr scored an and-1 to tie the game at 67 with 5:29 left, and Utah Tech's Christian Gibson later tied it again at 71 with 1:37 remaining. Cooper answered with a 3-pointer with 1:14 left to give Cal a 74-71 lead. Ethan Potter cut the margin to one before Indrusaitis scored with 17 seconds remaining and converted the free throw to make it 77-73. Georgia transfer Jake Wilkins added two free throws in the final seconds. Indrusaitis shot 7 of 13 from the field and 6 of 7 at the line. Cooper went 8 of 17 and made three 3-pointers. Gibson led Utah Tech (1-3) with 22 points, while Potter finished with 16 points and 10 rebounds. Utah Tech shot 52% from the field, while Cal grabbed 20 offensive rebounds and forced 14 turnovers. Up next California: Hosts East Texas A&M on Thursday. Utah Tech: At Washington this Thursday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
